$comment: Alpine.JS HTML custom data, fed to vscode-html-language-server via lsp-html-custom-data. Authored 2026-05-03 from the Alpine.JS v3 directives reference at https://alpinejs.dev/directives. Format documented at https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-html-languageservice/blob/main/docs/customData.md

globalAttributes.name: x-data
globalAttributes.description: Declare a new Alpine component and its data for a block of markup.

globalAttributes.name: x-init
globalAttributes.description: Run an expression when an element is initialised.

globalAttributes.name: x-show
globalAttributes.description: Toggle the visibility of an element via display: none.

globalAttributes.name: x-bind
globalAttributes.description: Dynamically bind an attribute to a JavaScript expression. Can be shortened to `:attribute`.

globalAttributes.name: x-on
globalAttributes.description: Listen for browser events on an element. Can be shortened to `@event`.

globalAttributes.name: x-text
globalAttributes.description: Set the text content of an element to the result of a JavaScript expression.

globalAttributes.name: x-html
globalAttributes.description: Set the inner HTML of an element to the result of a JavaScript expression.

globalAttributes.name: x-model
globalAttributes.description: Two-way bind a form input to a piece of Alpine state.

globalAttributes.name: x-modelable
globalAttributes.description: Allow a property to be exposed as the target of x-model on a parent component.

globalAttributes.name: x-for
globalAttributes.description: Repeat a block of HTML based on a data set, like a JavaScript for loop.

globalAttributes.name: x-transition
globalAttributes.description: Transition an element in and out using CSS classes or inline declarations.

globalAttributes.name: x-effect
globalAttributes.description: Re-run a JavaScript expression whenever any of its dependencies change.

globalAttributes.name: x-ignore
globalAttributes.description: Tell Alpine to skip initialising the element and its children.

globalAttributes.name: x-ref
globalAttributes.description: Mark an element so it can be referenced in expressions via $refs.<name>.

globalAttributes.name: x-cloak
globalAttributes.description: Hide an element while Alpine is initialising; remove with the `[x-cloak] { display: none !important }` CSS rule.

globalAttributes.name: x-teleport
globalAttributes.description: Move an element to another location in the DOM at runtime.

globalAttributes.name: x-if
globalAttributes.description: Conditionally render a <template> element. The block is added/removed from the DOM as the expression flips.

globalAttributes.name: x-id
globalAttributes.description: Generate a stable, deterministic id for use with $id().
